Text: WHILE a points transaction is Pending, the loyalty service shall exclude its points from the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: Points become available only after the return window (S-01); state Pending in models/state-points-transaction.md. Priority is open question Q5.

Text: WHILE a points transaction is Posted, the loyalty service shall include its points in the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: Posted points are the ones a member can redeem (S-01); state Posted in models/state-points-transaction.md.

Text: WHILE a points transaction is Pending, WHEN the POS sends a return for its purchase, the loyalty service shall reverse the transaction without changing the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: Returns reverse the original points (S-01); pending points were never redeemable. Cell Pending x returnReceived (T6).

Text: WHILE a points transaction is Posted, WHEN the POS sends a return for its purchase, the loyalty service shall deduct the transaction's points from the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: Returns reverse the original points (S-01). Cell Posted x returnReceived (T8).

Text: WHILE a points transaction is Expired, WHEN the POS sends a return for its purchase, the loyalty service shall leave the member's points balance unchanged.
Rationale: Expired points are already gone; Head of Loyalty confirmed nothing changes. Cell Expired x returnReceived (ignored).

Text: WHILE a points transaction is OnHold, the loyalty service shall exclude its points from the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: Held points must not be redeemable before the fraud engine releases them (R-025); state OnHold.

Text: WHILE a points transaction is OnHold, WHEN the POS sends a return for its purchase, the loyalty service shall reverse the transaction without changing the member's redeemable balance.
Rationale: Returns reverse the original points (S-01); held points were never redeemable. Cell OnHold x returnReceived (T7).
